entries.title: End a voice call in the Aura app
entries.summary: In the Aura phone app, tapping the same mic orb that started the voice call also ends it; Buddy never ends the call from something the user says.

answers.voice: Whenever you're done, tap the same mic orb you used to start our call and it ends right away. I'll never hang up on you myself mid-conversation.
answers.chat: In the Aura app, the mic orb is a toggle: tap it to start a Buddy voice call and tap it again to end the call. Buddy never ends the call from something you say; only your tap ends it, and a long silence eventually times the session out.

entries.title: How Buddy hears and speaks in a voice call
entries.summary: Voice sessions carry the user's speech to Buddy through live speech-to-text; replies are spoken through text-to-speech, or shown as live captions when audio is muted.

answers.voice: Yes, I can hear you. Your words reach me through live speech-to-text as you speak, and my replies are spoken aloud. If you mute my voice, you'll see my words as live captions instead. Either way, just talk; you never need to type during a call.
answers.chat: In a Buddy voice call your speech reaches Buddy through live speech-to-text, and replies come back through text-to-speech. If you mute Buddy's audio, the words appear as live captions instead of being spoken, while you keep talking normally. You never need to type during a voice call.
